body_html: Overall good show. There was not a ton of dancing but it didn’t seem like much of a dancing crowd at all. Lots of thanks and people saying they enjoyed the music though.”,”Congratulations to our beautiful new couple. The two of you looked great today and congratulations doesn’t even speak enough. It was an honor to be a part of such a lovely wedding reception at Spirit of Christ Catholic Community Church. Once we got dancing though, everyone was on the dance floor for the line dancing songs! Another stellar wedding by JAMMIN’ DJs without a doubt!
